fact: ISO's member page lists the Standards Organisation of Nigeria as Nigeria's ISO member body, participating in 109 technical committees.
The ISO/IEC JTC 1 participation page, captured May 2026, lists SON of Nigeria as a participating member of JTC 1, Information technology.
ISO/IEC JTC 1 lists Nigeria among the P-members (participating members) of its 50th plenary, held 10-14 November 2025 in Chengdu.
